questions.stem: Which pair correctly matches a transport vessel with what it carries?

options.text: Capillaries carry blood at high pressure; arteries carry blood at low pressure
Xylem carries water and minerals; phloem carries dissolved sugars
Arteries carry deoxygenated blood; veins carry oxygenated blood
Xylem carries dissolved sugars; phloem carries water and minerals

questions.explanation: Xylem vessels transport water and dissolved mineral ions from the roots to the leaves. Phloem sieve tubes transport dissolved sugars (mainly sucrose) from sources (such as leaves) to sinks (such as roots and growing tips).
